results.question: Name of Work
results.answer: Detail Design, Procurement, Construction, Testing and Commissioning of Extension to Vidhan Bhavan Construction of New Administrative Building Part 2 at Civil Lines, Nagpur on EPC Basis
results.source: eProcurement System Government of Maharashtra_compressed.pdf, Page 1, Work /Item(s)

results.question: Scope of work
results.answer: Detailed Design, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Testing, Commissioning, and Handover of the works within Plot 02. Executed in two phases: Phase 1 includes Shell & Core (Structure, Façade & High side MEPF, demolition of temporary structures, construction of West and East Blocks, external development). Phase 2 includes internal finishes, interior fit-outs, internal MEPF, AV, acoustics, CCTV, access control, final integration, testing, and commissioning.
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 6-7, Clause 6

results.question: Type of Project/ Building/
results.answer: Government Administrative Building / Legislative Complex Extension (Civil Works)

results.question: Site Visit/ Site Location
results.answer: The Project Site is located within the Vidhan Bhavan precinct at Civil Lines, Nagpur, Maharashtra. The EPC Contractor is required to verify and supplement all survey, site, and interface information necessary for the detailed design and execution of the Plot 02 works.
results.source: SCHAAnnexure1Site_compressed.pdf, Page 6, Clause 2.1 & Page 7, Clause 2.9

results.question: Built up Area
results.answer: The total Built-up Area of the Project shall be governed by the latest approved architectural area statement forming part of the Contract Documents. The Basement Area is specified as 3609.57 sq.m (for Basement-03 and Basement-02) and 3321.78 sq.m (for Basement-01) in the drawings.
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 6, Clause 5.3; P02ARCHITECTUREDRAWINGPart1_compressed.pdf, Page 5, 22, 23, 24

results.question: Site Area
results.answer: Approx. 8188.87 sq.m (2.02 acres) as per Clause 2.2, or 7970.10 Sq.m. (1.96 acre) as per Clause 3.2.
results.source: SCHAAnnexure1Site_compressed.pdf, Page 6, Clause 2.2 & Page 8, Clause 3.2

results.question: Minimum value of work to be executed interim RA payment
List of approved make/Agencies
results.answer: The comprehensive Approved Make List is provided in a separate tender document titled 'VOL3APPROVEDMAKELISTPART02.pdf' (referenced on Page 2 of eProcurement System Government of Maharashtra). Additionally, specific approved makes/products are mentioned throughout the Broad Scope of Work (Schedule B: Annexure 2A), such as UltraTech Fixoblock (Page 51), Alumil Smartia M7 (Page 52), AkzoNobel or Jotun powder coatings (Page 53), and Doka or Cuplock formwork (Page 31).
results.source: eProcurement System Government of Maharashtra_compressed.pdf, Page 2, Item 21; and SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Pages 31, 51, 52, 53

results.question: Water Supply
results.answer: The EPC Contractor is responsible for designing, providing, maintaining, and removing temporary water supply as part of the temporary works required for the safe execution of the Project.
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 10, Clause 6.8 (Temporary Works)

results.question: Electricity Supply
results.answer: The EPC Contractor is responsible for designing, providing, maintaining, and removing temporary electrical supply and temporary lighting as part of the temporary works (Page 10, Clause 6.8). Additionally, the permanent works include the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of a 1250KVA / 1000 KW Diesel Generating Set (Page 69, Item 5).
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 10 (Clause 6.8) and Page 69 (Item 5)

results.question: First Aid Facilities & Emergency Set-up
results.answer: The Contractor's HSE Management System must include First Aid Facilities. Additionally, the Contractor must supply a standard first aid box containing antiseptic cream, medicine for burns, crepe bandages, gauge bandages, medicated ready-to-use bandages, adhesive tape, scissors, and anti-septic solution under Substation Safety Equipment.
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 21, Clause 12.3 & Page 70, Item 11

results.question: Material & Samples
results.answer: All relevant samples must be approved by the Architect prior to procurement. Mock-ups shall be prepared wherever directed by the Employer, Architect, or PMC, and bulk execution shall commence only after approval of the respective mock-up.
results.source: P02ARCHITECTUREDRAWINGPart1_compressed.pdf, Page 3, General Note 13 & SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 24, Clause 17.3 & 17.4

results.question: Material Testing Laboratory
results.answer: The Contractor shall maintain a certified testing lab at site with minimum facilities/equipments as per the attached plan specified in the Contract Conditions, which must be approved by the Structural Consultant.
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 30, Clause 3.0(e)

results.question: Barricading
results.answer: Providing and maintaining barricading on the site 5 m high by using MS Pipes or angle iron framework of verticals at 3 m c/c and horizontals at 0.90 m c/c, Galvalume sheets, Struts, MS Clamps, etc.
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 52, Item 10.1

results.question: Water spraying
results.answer: The EPC Contractor shall implement suitable environmental protection measures including dust suppression by water sprinkling or equivalent approved methods, and prepare a Dust Suppression and Air Quality Management Plan.
results.source: SCHAAnnexure3EnvironmentalClearance_compressed.pdf, Page 4, Clause 7(a) & Clause 6(b)

results.question: Use Of Low-Voc Paints/Adhesives/Sealants
results.answer: The ramp intermediate slab area waterproofing requires a Green Level certified, low VOC, solvent-free, elastomeric, flexible polyurethane trafficable car park decking system.
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 44, Clause 6.9(I)

results.question: Site Signages
results.answer: Cast iron signage (900mm height, 510mm width) and signage light (9W LED) are specified under Landscaping. Additionally, display boards and sign boards are required for the Solar PV System.
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 88, Item 4 & 5 & Page 75, Item 65

results.question: Office for Client
results.answer: The Contractor is required to provide Site Establishments including a Site Office for the Contractor, PMC, and Employer under Preliminaries and site setup. Specific details regarding furniture, AC, or laptops are not specified.
results.source: SCHBAnnexure1BroadScopeofwork_compressed.pdf, Page 27, Item 0

results.question: Plants & Machinery
results.answer: The contractor is required to provide or set up: a fully automatic micro-processor-based PLC with SCADA enabled reversible Drum Type mixer/concrete Batch mix plant (Pan mixer) (Page 30, Clause 2.1); a dedicated computerized RMC plant of adequate capacity at site (Page 31, Clause 3.0(j)); adequate capacity cranes for lifting and lowering steel sections (Page 37, Clause 4.0(ii)); and site establishments including a laboratory, rebar yard, water treatment plant, and batching plants (Page 27, Clause 0).
results.source: SCHB Annexure 1 Broad Scope of Work, Pages 27, 30, 31, and 37
